points.description: States that the collision domain diameter (maximum network length) decreases, by a factor of about 10 (e.g. 300m to 30m, or 10 times shorter). Must say decrease/shrinks and give the factor of 10 (or equivalent such as 'one tenth'). Saying only 'decreases' with no factor, or an increase/no change, earns no marks.

levels.says: States the diameter decreases/gets smaller but gives no factor or a wrong factor.

rubric.notes: Full mark for diameter decreasing by a factor of 10 (example numbers optional). Half mark for decrease with no or wrong factor. No marks for increase or no change.
